# Yeackbot delivery plan, UX and risk

> **Model update (2026-10-16, owner):** every LLM call now runs on **Claude Haiku 5.5** (`low` effort, thinking off except the Ask tool loop) through the route table in `packages/server/src/llm/models.ts`; see PLAN.md "Models, cost and caching". Haiku has no server-side refusal fallback, so refusals are recorded and skipped (only a route overridden to Sonnet 5.5 sends `fallbacks` and re-runs a refused batch item). Mentions of Opus 5.5, its prices, effort `medium` or `fallbacks` on every synchronous call below are superseded.

## What I checked on this Mac today

These findings change the plan.

- **The Cloudflare zone is probably already in his account.**
  - `yeackbot.com` uses the same Cloudflare nameserver pair as the owner's other zones, so it is almost certainly the same account.
  - There is no apex record yet. Spike (c) shrinks to creating a tunnel and an Access app.
  - Gotcha: `cloudflared tunnel route dns` writes into the zone of the cert in use, and `~/.cloudflared` already holds more than one zone cert. Create the CNAME in the dashboard instead.
- **One power cut takes everything down.**
  - FileVault is on, auto-login is off, `pmset autorestart` is 0, and `AutomaticallyInstallMacOSUpdates` is 1.
  - Everything we need runs in the GUI session: the helper, Messages, WhatsApp, Beeper, the node LaunchAgent and cloudflared. An unplanned reboot or power cut leaves all of it down until he unlocks the Mac in person.
  - Automatic minor macOS updates can silently change how chat.db and Messages scripting behave.
- **There is no Developer ID Application certificate in the keychain.**
  - The keychain has one Apple Development identity and 10 Apple Distribution identities for team 37NR4Z7NT6.
  - Permission grants (TCC) that survive cert renewals need Developer ID signing. Creating that cert is a manual Account Holder step.
- **Ports 4320–4322 are free.** `com.properthought.caffeinate` already keeps the Mac awake, so reuse it rather than adding another.
- **WhatsApp and Beeper are still not installed.**
- **iMessage history is being lost every day.** chat.db starts on 2025-10-03, which fits a 1-year Keep Messages setting, so about a day of history drops off daily. Setting Keep Messages to Forever is a Day-0 action.

## Runtime shape this plan assumes

| Process | Runs as | Owns | Bind |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Yeackbot Helper.app**: new xcodegen target `YeackbotHelper`, bundle `com.yeackbot.helper`, Developer ID, hardened runtime plus the apple-events entitlement, IMsgCore pinned to 0.16.0 | SMAppService login item in the GUI session | All TCC permissions: Full Disk Access, Contacts, Calendars, Automation→Messages. Decodes chat.db, reads CNContactStore and EventKit, copies the WhatsApp databases, sends iMessage | 127.0.0.1:4321, bearer token in `~/Library/Application Support/Yeackbot/helper.token` (0600) |
| **com.yeackbot.server**: node 25, Express 5, better-sqlite3 WAL; database at `~/Library/Application Support/Yeackbot/yeackbot.db`, outside the repo | LaunchAgent, copied from FI's `scripts/service.sh` | All logic: jobs, Beeper, Partiful, Anthropic, web push. It holds no TCC permissions | 127.0.0.1:4320 |
| **com.cloudflare.yeackbot** | LaunchAgent | `cloudflared tunnel --no-autoupdate --config ~/.cloudflared/yeackbot.yml run yeackbot` | – |
| Messages.app, WhatsApp.app, Beeper Desktop | Login items | Sources | Beeper stays on loopback :23373 |

**Hard guarantee:** the helper's `/v1/send` rejects any recipient not in `SELF_HANDLES`. The agent therefore has no code path that can text anyone other than Michael.

## 1. Phased roadmap

### Day 0: user kickoff (about 45 minutes)
This starts the slow clocks. Each step is detailed in §5.
- Keep Messages: Forever.
- Request the Instagram "Download your information" (DYI) JSON export.
- Install and link WhatsApp for Mac.
- Install Beeper and connect Instagram only.
- Create a Developer ID certificate.
- Turn off automatic macOS installs and set `pmset autorestart 1`.

### Phase 0: spikes plus "hello yeackbot.com" (4 dev days)
Phase 0 overlaps with the Beeper backfill and the wait for the DYI export.

**What he gets:**
- yeackbot.com behind Google SSO, installed on his iPhone's home screen.
- A test push that reaches the locked phone.
- A helper in the menu bar that can text "🅨 hello" to himself, with his reply showing up on the Sources page.

- **iPhone:** Add to Home Screen → open → Settings → Enable notifications → "Send test push" → lock the phone → the push arrives → tapping opens Today with no login.
- **Text:** helper menu "Send test to me" → the note-to-self thread shows `🅨 hello <nonce>`. He types `ping` → Sources shows "self-thread: ping received in N s".

### Phase 1: read-only CRM with full iMessage history (8 dev days)
**What he gets:** every person with a full, correctly decoded iMessage timeline (including group chats) on his phone. Old data is imported. Nothing is sent yet.

**Scope:**
- **Monorepo** `yeackbot/` in this repo: `packages/{shared,server,web}` (`@yb/*`), esbuild-bundled server, vitest and supertest.
- **Schema:**
  - `persons`; `identities` (source, key, how_matched, confidence); `episodes` (lossless, unique on `(source, source_msg_id)`)
  - `chats`, `chat_members`, `collections` (tag, group, location, circle), `notes`
  - `agent_actions` (the journal), `source_state`, `settings`
- **Legacy import** (`import:legacy --dry-run`, then apply; idempotent on ZID):
  - Contacts, with the merge chain becoming identities on the surviving person. Hidden flags, priority. Tags, groups and locations with their 18, 92 and 43 memberships. 1 note. 2 activities become manual events.
  - The 18,741 legacy interactions are matched to chat.db episodes on (person, ±2 s, text). Unmatched ones are kept as `source='legacy'`.
- **Address book** via the helper's CNContactStore. Instagram usernames come from `value.service`, fixing the old label bug.
- **chat.db, all history**, via the helper:
  - Decoded text, chat context, `handle_id=0` sends, tapbacks stored as reactions rather than interactions, link-preview rows merged, a `date_edited` re-scan, and a 48 h overlap.
  - Short codes, `urn:biz` and spam are kept as episodes but excluded from people.
- **Deterministic identity resolution:**
  - Keys: E.164 via `libphonenumber-js` (default region US), lowercased email, address-book ID, IG username from the address book.
  - Auto-create a person for a handle with ≥1 outgoing message or with membership in a group that has known people.
  - Port `nameKey` with the per-component trim fix.
- **Screens:** People and Person (Overview and Timeline), Collections, Sources (iMessage, Contacts, Legacy, Helper), Settings → Hidden & merged.
- **Backups:** nightly backup via the better-sqlite3 backup API (14 daily, 8 weekly). No backup UI.

**Exit criteria:**
- `npm run verify:imessage` reports chat.db-side and DB-side message counts under identical filters. They agree within 0.5%, and ≥99% of text-bearing episodes have non-empty text.
- The legacy reconciliation table matches exactly for collections, memberships and notes. The live non-hidden person count is accounted for line by line.
- A hidden fixture person appears in no API response except `/api/v1/settings/hidden`, enforced by a test against the `person_visible` view.
- The People list renders 1,500+ rows in under 1 s on the iPhone.

**Verification:**
- **Terminal:** `npm test`; `npm run verify:imessage`; `npm run import:legacy -- --dry-run` (counts only); `bash scripts/service.sh status`.
- **Browser:**
  - `/people` defaults to last name A→Z, with blank last names at the bottom. Search on "ri" shows avatar, name and company.
  - Open someone from a group chat: the timeline shows the group name and a session card. Messages he sent into the group appear.
  - `/sources`: the iMessage cursor equals `MAX(ROWID)` within 10 minutes, and the "oldest message" date is shown.
- **Text:** none.

### Phase 2: the daily agent loop (8 dev days)
**What he gets:** the first real 8:00 brief in iMessage plus a push; he can reply to it. Today shows "what the agent did" with Undo. Network graph v1.

**Scope:**
- **Scheduler:** in-process, checked at startup and hourly; nightly run at 03:00.
- **Sessionizer:** 90-minute gap.
- **Cadence model:**
  - Baseline is the median gap over the trailing 12 months, with 1:1 weighted above group-only.
  - Fading when silence is ≥3× the median, ≥21 days, and strength is in the top 40%.
  - Momentum compares a 90-day EWMA with a 365-day EWMA. Reciprocity is the share of sessions he starts.
- **Reply debt, deterministic v1:**
  - 1:1 chats only. The last message is inbound, is a question or request, is over 20 h old, and is not a tapback or "ok/lol/👍".
  - Closes automatically when he next messages that person.
- **Fuzzy dedup**, applied automatically and journaled:
  - Never merges on name alone; requires name plus ≥1 independent signal (shared group, shared identifier).
  - Hard blocks: two address-book cards with different numbers; the do-not-merge list.
- **Co-membership edges:** weighted by 1/size and recency.
- **Auto circles v1:** Louvain clustering via `graphology-communities-louvain`. Named from group display names; LLM naming arrives in Phase 5.
- **Ranker:** cap 4, at most 2 of one kind, 14-day per-person cooldown after a skip, 90-day suppression after a dismissal.
- **Digest composer:** deterministic templates only.
- **Delivery:** helper send with 8 s verification; command poller every 10 s; grammar parser and acks; Web Push.
- **Screens:** Today, Network (sigma).
- **Undo engine:**
  - Each action type has an inverse.
  - An undo also writes a constraint so the agent doesn't redo it: a do-not-merge pair, a rejected-fact hash, or a circle exclusion.

**Exit criteria:**
- 5 consecutive weekday digests arrive at 08:00 ±2 min, each followed by a push.
- `help`, `done N`, `snooze N 2w`, `skip N`, `wrong N`, `undo`, `pause`, `resume` and `more` each get an ack in under 60 s.
- Replaying the full self-thread twice causes zero double-processing and zero bot rows read as commands (CI test against a synthetic chat.db).
- Undoing a merge restores a byte-identical person and identity snapshot (test).
- He rates at least 60% of fading items "fair" during the week.

**Verification:**
- **Terminal:** `npm test`; `npm run pipeline:run -- --dry` prints the candidate list as counts by kind; `npm run digest:preview` prints the exact text without sending.
- **Browser:**
  - `/today` lists the items and last night's actions. Undo one merge, then confirm both people and their timelines are back. Re-run the pipeline and confirm it does not re-merge them.
  - `/network`: filter by circle, tap a node to get its sheet, open the person.
- **Text:** `help`; `done 1`; `snooze 2 2w`; `skip 3`; `undo`; `pause` (the next morning has no digest); `resume`.

### Phase 3: cutover and retirement of the old system (2 dev days plus a 7-day parallel run)
**What he gets:** one system, and the forgeable public sync endpoint is closed.

**Steps:**
1. Freeze the native apps (he stops editing).
2. Run the final `import:legacy` delta, which must report zero new rows on a second run.
3. Archive `default.store` together with its `-wal` file as a read-only tar plus sha256 under `…/Yeackbot/archive/`.
4. Quit BlackbookServer and remove it from Login Items.
5. Remove the `sync.libersecretorum.com` DNS record and its tunnel, and bootout `com.cloudflare.libersecretorum`.
6. Delete the native apps from the iPhone and Mac.
7. Do a restore drill from the nightly backup into a scratch DB, then run `verify:*`.

**Exit and verification:**
- `lsof -nP -iTCP:8765` is empty.
- `curl -sI https://sync.libersecretorum.com` no longer reaches the origin.
- The restore drill passes.
- An entry is appended to `docs/test-scenarios/TEST_SCENARIOS.md`.

### Phase 4: all sources (10 dev days)
**What he gets:** a cross-source timeline with source badges, Instagram and WhatsApp accounts linked to people, Partiful events with attendees, and fading that is no longer fooled by friends who are WhatsApp-only.

**Scope and effort:**
- **WhatsApp (3 days):** snapshot every 30 minutes, ingest by `Z_PK` watermark, LID→phone mapping, a `MAX(Z_PK)` drop triggers a full re-upsert, group rosters become edges.
- **Beeper Instagram (2.5 days):**
  - Only accounts whose network is Instagram are read.
  - Per-chat cursors, polled hourly. Participant IG numeric IDs become identities.
  - Health is based on account status.
- **DYI import (1.5 days):** search the archive for files rather than hard-coding paths; fix mojibake (latin1→utf8); followers/following dates; idempotent against Beeper episodes.
- **Partiful (3 days):**
  - Daily API sync with tolerant Zod (`.passthrough()`).
  - Guests become co-attendance edges, weighted by status and 1/log(size).
  - `socials.instagram` provides an IG identity seed.
  - chat.db text parser for `urn:biz:29896aa3…` and 39781, covering invite, RSVP, reminder and blast. Any event seen in texts but missing from the API triggers a contract alert.
- **Probabilistic identity (1–2 days):**
  - Jaro-Winkler with a nickname table, plus graph overlap, plus IG/Partiful seeds.
  - Auto-apply at ≥0.9 with ≥2 independent signal types. Below that, no link.
- **Events screen v1.**

**Exit criteria:** every source card is green for 3 nights in a row. Then the failure drills:
- Quit WhatsApp for 1 day: an alert line appears.
- Revoke the Beeper token: "Needs you" appears.
- Corrupt the Partiful token: "Recapture token" appears.

**Verification:**
- **Terminal:**
  - `npm run verify:sources` prints per source: episodes, oldest and newest, identity link rate, LID map rate.
  - `npm run partiful:probe` and `npm run beeper:probe`, counts only.
- **Browser:**
  - A person who is on both WhatsApp and iMessage shows both badges and an interleaved timeline.
  - `/events` past tab: an event with attendees shown as chips.
  - DYI spot-check: an accented or emoji name renders correctly.

### Phase 5: intelligence via LLM (9 dev days)
**What he gets:** interests and facts with evidence, commitments that close themselves, LLM-written digest copy, conversation starters, `log:` by text, and Ask on the web and by iMessage.

**Scope:**
- **Pseudonymizer:** replace known handles exactly from the identity table, plus regex for unknown phones and emails. URLs become their domain. OTP, short-code and business messages are dropped. Per-person and per-chat exclusion list. A **pre-send scanner fails the batch** if a raw E.164 number or email remains.
- **Extraction:** nightly Haiku 5.5 batch at effort low, with a byte-stable 1-hour cached prefix. Output is ADD/UPDATE/INVALIDATE/NOOP deltas. Each fact must quote its cited message verbatim, or it is rejected.
- **Interests:** auto-applied at confidence ≥0.85 with ≥2 supporting messages. `sensitive=true` facts are never rendered in iMessage or push.
- **Commitments:** auto-close when a later interaction, a calendar event or an RSVP matches.
- **Reply debt v2:** an LLM `needs_reply` check on the deterministic candidates.
- **Interactive intent parser** for free text (Messages API, not batch). Free text counts only within 12 h of a bot message, or when prefixed with `yb`.
- **Ask:** retrieval over facts, graph and SQLite FTS5, with answers that cite sources, streamed by SSE.
- **Golden set:** a labeling UI at `/settings/eval`; he labels 150–200 windows in about 45 minutes.
- **Cost:** monthly hard cap, default $40. At the cap the LLM stages are skipped and the deterministic digest still goes out.

**Exit criteria:**
- 7 nights at ≤$1.50 per day.
- Golden-set precision: facts ≥0.90, commitments ≥0.85, needs-reply ≥0.85. Groundedness 100%.
- Every prompt or model change is gated by `npm run eval`.

**Verification:**
- **Terminal:** `npm run eval -- --set golden` prints per-field precision and recall; the Sources cost panel shows cache-hit % and $ month to date.
- **Browser:** person → Facts → evidence popover shows quote, date and source. "Wrong" invalidates the fact, and it does not come back the next night.
- **Text:** `log: coffee w/ Sam, he's moving to Denver` (ack plus a location fact); `who do I know in Austin?` (cited reply within 30 s); `wrong 2`.

### Phase 6: event and travel intel, intros, weekly review (6 dev days)
**What he gets:**
- A day-after Partiful follow-up in the next morning's digest.
- A pre-event brief on the morning of an event.
- "3 friends in Austin" from a calendar trip (the helper reads EventKit, which replaces the old Google OAuth).
- LLM-named auto circles.
- Intro suggestions, at most 1 a week and only shown to him.
- A Sunday weekly review.

**Exit criteria:** a test calendar event "Flight to Austin" next week produces a travel item the next morning. A past Partiful event produces a follow-up. The Sunday review arrives.

## 2. Information architecture and key screens

**Frontend stack:** the same as Financial Independence.
- React 19, Vite 8, react-router 8 in SPA mode, TanStack Query 5.
- `tokens.css` plus FI's own components ported over (AppShell, Dialog, Menu, Toast). No component kit.
- Added pieces: `@tanstack/react-virtual` for the People list, `sigma` v3 + `graphology` + `@react-sigma/core` + `graphology-layout-forceatlas2/worker` for the graph, `vite-plugin-pwa` (injectManifest), `date-fns`.
- Zod schemas live in `@yb/shared`.
- Sigma rather than react-force-graph: WebGL handles 2–3k nodes, and touch pinch-zoom on iPhone is smooth.

**Navigation:**
- Mobile bottom tabs: **Today · People · Ask · Network · More**. More holds Circles, Events, Sources and Settings.
- Desktop gets a left sidebar with all eight.
- Global search: ⌘K, or the search field on People.

**Routes:** `/today` (the default), `/people`, `/p/:shortId`, `/network`, `/circles` (segmented Circles | Tags | Locations), `/c/:id`, `/events`, `/e/:id`, `/ask`, `/sources`, `/settings` (including `/settings/hidden`, `/settings/devices`, `/settings/eval`).

**UX rules carried over:**
- **Hidden and merged people are excluded at one point only:** a server-side `person_visible` view that every endpoint uses. The only exception is `/settings/hidden`.
- **Every avatar and chip is a `<PersonLink>`** to `/p/:id`.
- **Default sort** is last name A→Z using `Intl.Collator(undefined,{sensitivity:'base'})`, first name as tiebreaker, blank last names last.
- **Search results** show avatar, name and company/handle.
- **One shared `EntityRow` component:** 36 px avatar or icon (radius 8), title up to 2 lines, caption subtitle, trailing slot.
- **Collections** follow list → detail → ⋯ menu. The agent never deletes or edits manual collections; deletes happen only when he explicitly asks.
- **Visual tokens:** gold accent. States are Strong (green), Cooling (amber), Fading (red), Dormant (gray).
- **Layout:**
  - Mobile-first with 16 px gutters, no horizontal scroll at 320 px, and `env(safe-area-inset-*)` for standalone mode.
  - Dark mode via `prefers-color-scheme`.
  - Content max-width 760 px on desktop.

**Screens:**

- **Today**
  1. Header: date plus delivery status ("Sent 8:00 via iMessage ✓ · push ✓").
  2. **Today's items** as cards. Actions: **Done**, **Snooze** (1w / 2w / 1m / pick), **Skip**, and a ⋯ menu with **Wrong** and **Why this?**. "Why this?" shows the cadence numbers and evidence quotes.
  3. An **Open loops** strip (reply debt n · promises n) that expands.
  4. **"What the agent did"**: grouped by run ("Last night 3:12 AM · 23 changes"). Each row is a sentence plus its evidence and an **Undo**. Undone rows are struck through with **Redo**. Filter chips: merges, links, facts, edges, circles. "Undo entire run" asks for confirmation first.
  5. A **"Check these"** section pinned above the feed: auto-applied actions with lower confidence from the last 7 days.
  6. Empty state: "Nothing needs you today", plus the agent summary.
- **People**
  - Search across name, company and handles.
  - Sort: Last name (default), Recent, Fading (silence ÷ cadence), Strength, Added.
  - Filter chips: Circle, Tag, Location, Source, Status (fading, reply owed, open promise). OR within a facet, AND across facets.
  - Row: 40 px avatar, name, company or "3d · WhatsApp", source badges, strength dot.
- **Person**
  - **Header:** avatar, name, title @ company, city; a strength ring plus "usually every ~9d · last 41d ago"; a priority star.
  - **Segmented control:** Overview | Timeline | Connections.
  - **Overview, in order:**
    - Open loops: reply owed and promises, each with Done.
    - Conversation starters: 3 drafts with a Copy button, labeled "never sent".
    - Facts & interests: chips with an evidence popover and Wrong; invalidated facts under "History".
    - Linked accounts: each source badge shows the identity, how it was matched, the confidence, and Unlink (journaled).
    - Circles, Tags and Locations: editable.
    - Notes.
    - Merge history: shows identities merged into this person, each with "Split".
  - **Timeline:** sessionized cross-source cards (source icon, chat or group name, message count) that expand to show messages. Tapbacks collapse. Source filter. Deep-linkable as `?m=<episodeId>`.
  - **Connections:** relationship chips ("4 group chats", "3 events together", "partner (mentioned)") plus a mini ego-graph.
- **Network:** sigma with ForceAtlas2 in a worker and Louvain colors.
  - Filters: circle, edge source, minimum strength, window (90d / 1y / all).
  - Search focuses a node. Labels only for high-degree nodes when zoomed out.
  - Tapping a node opens a bottom sheet with "Open".
- **Circles:**
  - Auto circles (badged "auto"; the agent maintains membership but never deletes them) and manual groups.
  - Tags and Locations tabs.
  - Detail page: members sorted by last name, filter chips for the other two facets, "Suggested additions".
- **Events:**
  - Upcoming and Past tabs, from Partiful and the calendar.
  - Detail: venue and time, his RSVP, attendees as chips, "People you know going", the pre-event brief, follow-up status.
- **Ask:**
  - A chat thread. Answers include person chips and footnote citations that open the timeline at that message.
  - Suggested prompts. It shares a backend with the iMessage Q&A.
- **Sources:** one card per source.
  - Status pill: Healthy, Stale, Error or Needs you.
  - Last success, the cursor or watermark, ingest counts for 24 h and 7 d, and the oldest data date (the retention alarm).
  - Last 5 errors.
  - Actions: Run now, Re-scan 48 h, and "How to fix" with exact steps.
  - Helper card: permission matrix plus version.
  - Pipeline card: per-stage timings, batch ID, tokens, cache %, cost month to date, last backup.
- **Settings:**
  - **Digest:** time, weekly day and time, max items, pause.
  - **Push:** this device, test push, subscribed devices, "first names in notifications" (off by default).
  - **Agent:** fading multiplier, minimum days, cooldown, auto-merge threshold.
  - **Privacy:** pseudonymization shown as locked on; LLM exclusions; Hidden & merged with Unhide and Restore; do-not-merge pairs; "My identities".
  - **Data:** JSON export.
  - About.

## 3. Digest UX

**Rules:**
- The first character is the marker **🅨** (U+1F168). The parser ignores any row whose stored GUID was a bot send, or whose text starts with 🅨.
- At most 5 items (default 4), each main line ≤70 characters.
- Names are first name plus last initial.
- No phone numbers, emails, amounts, quotes over 6 words, or facts tagged sensitive.
- Links have no scheme (`yeackbot.com/p/7kq2`). Short IDs are stable 4-character base32 per person. If spike (a) shows that links create extra preview rows, fall back to one `yeackbot.com/today` link.
- The digest is always sent over iMessage, never SMS.

**Daily (Tue 08:00):**
```
🅨 Tue Oct 14 · 4 for today

1 Sam R. · quiet 41d (usually ~9d)
  last: his Denver move
  yeackbot.com/p/7kq2
2 Priya S. · asked about Sat dinner, 2d ago
  yeackbot.com/p/a81c
3 Jordan · you said you'd send the gym link (Thu)
  yeackbot.com/p/m4tz
4 Added 3 people from Fri "Rooftop" · say hi?
  yeackbot.com/e/rt19

Last night: 2 merges · 4 IG links · 11 facts
done 2 · snooze 1 2w · skip 3 · wrong 4 · undo · ask me anything
```

**Weekly (Sunday 09:00):**
```
🅨 Week of Oct 12 · review

Warming: Alex K., Mei L.
Cooling: Dan P., Chris B.
New: 5 people (3 via Partiful)
Open: 3 replies owed · 2 promises

1 Dan P. · cooling 5 wks · coffee?
  yeackbot.com/p/d2pa
2 Climbing crew · no plans since Aug
  yeackbot.com/c/clmb

Agent this week: 9 merges · 31 facts · undo at yeackbot.com/today
```

**Acks and answers:**
- `🅨 ✓ 2 done (Priya) · 1 snoozed → Oct 28`
- `🅨 Logged for Sam R.: coffee today · "moving to Denver" (reply undo to revert)`
- `🅨 Austin · 3 people:` followed by one line per person: `• Sam R. (moved Sep) yeackbot.com/p/7kq2`
- **Health line**, at most one per digest: `⚠ WhatsApp quiet 4d · open WhatsApp on your phone`

**Grammar:**
- `done N`, `snooze N 1w|2w|1m|<date>`, `skip N` (negative feedback), `wrong N` (undo plus a label), `undo` (the last agent action set from the latest digest or ack), `more`, `pause`, `resume`, `help`.
- Free text is read as `log:`, a question, or a command, but only within 12 h of a bot message or when prefixed with `yb`. This protects his own notes to self.
- Tapbacks on the digest count as "seen" only.

**Cadence:**
- Pipeline at 03:00 → batch results polled until 07:30 → compose at 07:45 → send at the configured time (default 08:00).
- If the batch isn't finished, send the deterministic items with "(more on web)".
- Catch-up: if the Mac was down, send until 11:00. After that, skip iMessage and update Today only.
- Quiet hours 22:00–07:00, except replies to his own commands, which go out immediately.

**Push:**
- Title "Yeackbot". Body "Your brief is ready · 4 things today", or "Your weekly review is ready".
- Critical health only: "Instagram needs attention · open Sources".
- No names unless he turns that on. Tapping opens `/today`.

**When there is nothing worth sending:**
- Skip both the iMessage and the push. Today shows "All clear".
- After 3 consecutive empty days, send one heartbeat line: `🅨 All quiet 3 days · 12 people added, nothing urgent.`
- The Sunday review always sends unless paused.
- A pipeline failure sends `🅨 Last night's run failed at <stage> · yeackbot.com/sources`.

## 4. Risk register

L = likelihood, I = impact.

| # | Risk | L | I | Mitigation | Detection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Unplanned reboot with FileVault on leaves everything down | M | H | UPS; `pmset autorestart 1`; manual updates; `sudo fdesetup authrestart` for planned restarts; all jobs idempotent | External check on `/healthz` (Cloudflare tunnel-health notification or a free uptime monitor) emails him |
| 2 | macOS 26.7/27 changes chat.db, Messages scripting or TCC | M | H | Turn off automatic macOS installs; hold 27 until imsg supports it; post-upgrade checklist; startup contract checks (PRAGMA columns, decode rate ≥95% on the last 500 messages) | Sources goes red; push |
| 3 | TCC grants lost after re-sign, cert change or moving the app | M | H | Developer ID (team-based designated requirement); fixed path and bundle ID; node holds no permissions; helper probes each permission without prompting | Helper card; nightly ingest stops with a "re-grant FDA" push |
| 4 | Self-thread confusion: bot rows or his personal notes read as commands; duplicate rows | M | M | 🅨 marker plus stored GUIDs; idempotency on GUID; 12 h / `yb` window; spike (a) | Replay test in CI; command log on Sources |
| 5 | iMessage send fails silently (ghost row, -1743, -1728) | M | M | Verify for 8 s; no blind retry (one retry only after a confirmed error, 5 min later); push still fires | Sources delivery card; push says "brief on web" |
| 6 | History lost to 1-year retention | H until fixed | H | Day-0 Forever; episodes kept permanently; backups | "Oldest chat.db date" moves forward → alarm |
| 7 | Meta checkpoint or lock on Instagram via Beeper | M | M | On-device; read-only; authenticator 2FA; hourly polls at most; never send; monthly DYI reconciliation | Beeper account status ≠ connected → Needs you |
| 8 | WhatsApp linked device logged out after ~14 days, app not running, or pruning | M | M | Login item; permanent archive; `Z_PK` drop → full re-upsert | Newest message >3 days old → digest health line |
| 9 | API or schema churn (Beeper, WhatsApp, Partiful) | H over 1 year | M | One adapter interface; tolerant Zod; pinned SDK; nightly contract tests; one failing source never blocks the run | Per-source contract alert |
| 10 | Partiful ToS breach or token revoked | L–M | L | 1 sync a day, ~10–50 read calls, browser-like headers; kill switch; chat.db texts as fallback | Refresh 4xx → "Recapture token" |
| 11 | **False merges by the fully automatic agent** | M | H | Deterministic keys first; never merge on name alone; hard blocks; do-not-merge memory from undos; pairwise precision ≥0.99 on a labeled set before fuzzy auto-merge is turned on; one-tap Split | "Check these" for 7 days; merge count in the weekly review; `wrong N` |
| 12 | Hallucinated facts | M | M | Verbatim quote check; evidence IDs; ≥0.85 and ≥2 messages; invalidate instead of delete; memory of rejected facts; eval gate | Groundedness and "wrong" rate on Sources |
| 13 | Sensitive content on the lock screen or in iMessage | L | H | Sensitive facts never rendered; generic push; composer linter blocks digits, emails and sensitive tags | Unit tests |
| 14 | Personal data exposed over the internet | L | H | Access policy for one email; origin verifies the Access JWT on every `/api` call; loopback binding; bypass paths carry no data; `Cache-Control: no-store`; Origin check on mutating requests; retire the forgeable `sync.libersecretorum.com` | Monthly `npm run audit:exposure` (curl matrix) |
| 15 | Personal data sent to Anthropic | M (by design) | M | Pseudonymize identifiers; drop OTP and business texts; URLs → domain; exclusion list; no attachments | Pre-send scanner fails the batch on a raw identifier |
| 16 | Prompt injection in message text | M | L–M | Extractor has no tools and returns schema only; the helper allowlist makes outbound to others impossible | Instruction-like facts flagged |
| 17 | Cost runaway | L | M | Batch, effort low, caching; cap on windows per night (400); monthly hard cap at $40; Console spend limit | Cost panel; push at 80% of the cap |
| 18 | PWA Access session or push subscription breaks | M | L–M | iMessage stays the content channel; 1-month session; handle 410 and resubscribe; test push | Devices list shows last successful push |
| 19 | Digest fatigue | M | M | Cap 4; skip when empty; cooldowns; `skip` feedback | If acted-on rate <20% for 2 weeks, cap drops to 3 automatically |
| 20 | Beeper also connects iMessage or WhatsApp (against his decision) | M | M | Setup connects Instagram only; adapter filters by network | Sources warning |
| 21 | Disk loss or a bad migration | L | H | Nightly backup plus Time Machine; automatic backup before each migration; restore drill in Phase 3 | "Last backup" age on Sources |
| 22 | Developer ID cert can't be created (not Account Holder) | M | M | Apple Development signing plus a yearly re-grant reminder | Helper health |
| 23 | Scope creep for a single developer | H | M | Phase gates and the §6 cut list | – |

## 5. Manual one-time steps for Michael

**Day 0 (urgent):**
1. iPhone: Settings → Apps → Messages → Keep Messages → **Forever**. Mac: Messages → Settings → General → Keep messages → **Forever**.
2. Instagram: Accounts Center → Your information and permissions → Download your information → JSON, all time, low media quality. When it arrives, drop the zip into `~/Library/Application Support/Yeackbot/imports/instagram/`.
3. WhatsApp: install from the Mac App Store, link by QR, turn on Open at Login. Open WhatsApp on the phone at least weekly.
4. Beeper:
   - Set up authenticator-app 2FA on Instagram first.
   - Install Beeper Desktop and sign in. Connect **Instagram only** (On-Device); skip iMessage and WhatsApp.
   - Settings → Developers → enable the Desktop API. Create a token under Approved connections and paste it into `npm run setup:beeper`.
   - Turn on Open at Login.
5. Apple Developer (Account Holder): create a **Developer ID Application** certificate (Xcode → Settings → Accounts → Manage Certificates → +).
6. Mac power and updates:
   - Run `sudo pmset -a autorestart 1`.
   - System Settings → General → Software Update → Automatic updates: **turn off "Install macOS updates"** and keep Security Responses on. Don't upgrade to macOS 27 yet.
   - Consider a UPS.

**Phase 0:**

7. Cloudflare Zero Trust:
   - Confirm or create the team domain.
   - Add Google as an identity provider: a Google Cloud OAuth client with redirect `https://<team>.cloudflareaccess.com/cdn-cgi/access/callback`. Add One-time PIN as a backup.
   - Create the "Yeackbot" Access app: Allow = his Gmail, session 1 month.
   - Create the Bypass app for `/healthz`, `/manifest.webmanifest`, `/icons/*`, `/apple-touch-icon*`.
   - Copy the AUD tag into `.env`.
   - Add the CNAME `yeackbot.com → <tunnel-uuid>.cfargotunnel.com` (proxied) in the dashboard.
8. Install Yeackbot Helper.app and approve:
   - Full Disk Access (System Settings → Privacy & Security → +).
   - The Contacts prompt.
   - The Calendars prompt (Full Access).
   - Automation → Messages, triggered by clicking "Send test to me".
   - Login Item on.
9. Anthropic Console: create an API key in a "yeackbot" workspace and set a monthly spend limit of about $60.
10. Partiful:
    - Log in at partiful.com in desktop Chrome.
    - DevTools → Application → IndexedDB → `firebaseLocalStorageDb` → copy the `stsTokenManager.refreshToken` and the uid.
    - Run `npm run setup:partiful`, which stores them in Keychain.
11. iPhone:
    - Open yeackbot.com in Safari and sign in with Google.
    - Share → Add to Home Screen.
    - Open it from the home screen, then Settings → Enable notifications → Allow → Send test push.
12. Give his own handles (phone and Apple ID email) to `npm run setup:self`. These become `SELF_HANDLES`, which is also the only allowed send target.

**Later:**

13. Phase 5: label the golden set at `/settings/eval` (about 45 minutes).
14. Phase 3 cutover: stop editing in the native apps, delete them, and remove BlackbookServer from Login Items. Claude handles the tunnel and DNS removal with his OK.
15. Optional, after Phase 4: make an encrypted Finder backup of the iPhone and enter its password at the WhatsApp backfill script's prompt.

## 6. Cut, defer and effort

**Cut, with replacements:**

| Cut | Replaced by |
|---|---|
| Backups UI | Automatic backups plus a Sources line |
| Subscription / StoreKit | – |
| Biometrics / App Lock | Access plus the device passcode |
| Auth screens; the sync protocol and Bonjour; port 8765 | Cloudflare Access |
| Google Calendar OAuth | EventKit in the helper |
| Manual Log Interaction form | `log:` texts and person notes |
| Reminders screen | Commitments and snooze |
| Smart Groups | People filters |
| Met-via / Introduced-to pickers | Graph edges |
| Scoring weight sliders | 3 agent thresholds |
| Per-cell table editing | – |
| AI Insights screen | Ask |
| LinkedIn enrichment | – |
| Photo upload | – |
| Life-event and birthday detection | – (not selected) |
| Sending drafts | Never; drafts are copy-only |

**Not built:**
- instagrapi follower diffs (ban risk).
- Playwright.
- Messenger, Signal and other Beeper networks.
- Splink: a TypeScript scorer is enough at this scale.
- Presidio: the identity table plus regex has better recall here.
- A multi-model cascade or Apple on-device triage: Haiku 5.5 at effort low throughout (one route can move to Sonnet 5.5 if the eval demands it).
- Offline data caching in the PWA: the shell only.
- Real-time WebSocket and file-system watchers: nightly runs plus the 10 s self-thread poll.
- Attachments and media.
- Message edit history beyond the 48 h re-scan.
- Full shadow tables: a prompt-version column and the eval gate instead.

**Deferred** until after Phase 6, and only if wanted:
- WhatsApp iPhone-backup backfill.
- Recurring scheduled DYI exports.
- A bot Apple ID, only if spike (a) fails and he approves.
- Unknown-number self-identification ("hey it's Jake").

**Effort:** Phase 0: 4 days · Phase 1: 8 · Phase 2: 8 · Phase 3: 2 (+7-day run) · Phase 4: 10 · Phase 5: 9 · Phase 6: 6 → **≈47 dev days, about 11 calendar weeks for one developer pairing with Claude Code (±25%)**.
